name: Sushi / Japanese Restaurant
description: A Japanese cuisine restaurant specializing in sushi, sashimi, ramen, and traditional dishes. Key differentiator: piece-count ordering, omakase/set menu tiers, and wasabi/ginger preferences.

sections.name: Nigiri
sections.description: Traditional Edomae and modern hand-pressed sushi featuring pristine slices of fresh, cured, or flame-torched seafood delicately draped over seasoned, hand-formed sushi rice pillows (shari). This core foundation of authentic Japanese dining celebrates seafood freshness, master knife-work, and rice seasoning balance, offering guests direct control over piece count and wasabi placement.

subSections.name: Classic Fish Nigiri
subSections.description: Timeless staples of the sushi counter highlighting fresh cuts of tuna, salmon, yellowtail, sea bream, mackerel, and sweet boiled shrimp pressed onto seasoned sushi rice.

subSections.name: Premium & Specialty Nigiri
subSections.description: Luxurious and seasonal delicacies such as fatty bluefin tuna (otoro, chutoro), sea urchin (uni), freshwater eel (unagi), sweet botan shrimp, and torch-seared A5 wagyu beef brushed with nikiri soy.

subSections.name: Tamago & Vegetable Nigiri
subSections.description: Delicate layered sweet dashi egg omelet (tamago), seasoned shiitake mushrooms, ripe avocado, and pickled daikon for vegetarian and palate-cleansing options.

choices.label: Wasabi on the Side Only (No Wasabi Inside)
Extra Wasabi Inside & On the Side
Aburi Style (Lightly Flame-Torched with House Nikiri Soy)
Seared with Yuzu Kosho & Smoked Sea Salt

Side of House-Brewed Nikiri Sweet Soy

sections.name: Sashimi
sections.description: The purest expression of Japanese culinary craftsmanship, highlighting impeccably fresh, raw seafood sliced with surgical precision and served without rice. Designed for diners seeking pristine texture, umami depth, and delicate marine sweetness, served chilled over crushed ice with fresh daikon tsuma and shiso leaves.

subSections.name: Single Fish Sashimi
subSections.description: Pristine individual fish varietals sliced to order, highlighting specific textures and rich flavors of single species such as salmon, yellowtail, bluefin tuna, red snapper, or scallop.

subSections.name: Mixed Sashimi Platters
subSections.description: Elaborate chef-selected assortments of multiple seafood varieties presented harmoniously on crushed ice with edible flowers, shiso, and shredded daikon for table sharing or multi-fish tastings.

choices.label: Traditional Sliced (Hirazukuri on Crushed Ice with Daikon & Shiso)
Carpaccio Style (Thinly Sliced with Microgreens, Truffle Soy & Ponzu)
Tataki Style (Lightly Flash-Seared Crust with Citrus Ponzu & Scallions)
Fresh Shizuoka Real Wasabi Root (Freshly Grated)
Citrus Ponzu Sauce with Daikon Oroshi

sections.name: Maki Rolls
sections.description: Classic and contemporary rolled sushi wrapped in toasted nori seaweed with seasoned sushi rice, featuring clean single-ingredient hosomaki, inverted uramaki rolls, and crisp hand-rolled cones (temaki). This staple section satisfies traditional sushi purists and casual roll enthusiasts alike with customizable rice types, piece counts, and dipping accompaniments.

subSections.name: Classic Maki
subSections.description: Traditional slender nori-wrapped rolls (hosomaki) focusing on pure, focused fillings such as fresh tuna, salmon, cucumber, avocado, or fermented soybean (natto).

subSections.name: Inside-Out Rolls (Uramaki)
subSections.description: Popular inverted rolls featuring sushi rice on the exterior, coated with toasted sesame seeds or bright flying fish roe (tobiko) encasing balanced combinations of seafood and vegetables.

subSections.name: Hand Rolls (Temaki)
subSections.description: Individual crisp nori seaweed cones packed fresh to order with warm sushi rice, cool sashimi cuts, and crispy cucumber matchsticks, crafted for instant hand-held enjoyment.

choices.label: Substitute Nori with Delicate Soy Paper (Mamenori)
Riceless Wrapped in Thin Cucumber Sheet (Naruto Style)
Add Sweet Unagi Eel Sauce Drizzle
Add Spicy Japanese Kewpie Mayo Inside

sections.name: Specialty & Signature Rolls
sections.description: Elevated, multi-layered sushi masterpieces crafted by our head chefs, combining premium raw seafood, succulent torch-seared delicacies, crunchy tempura elements, and luscious artisanal sauces. These vibrant showpiece rolls deliver complex flavor contrasts and dramatic visual presentations tailored for adventurous diners.

subSections.name: House Specials
subSections.description: Exclusive chef-curated signature creations blending premium seafood, torch-seared accents, black truffle oil, and complex house-made emulsions.

subSections.name: Dragon & Rainbow Rolls
subSections.description: Stunning decorative rolls draped with cascading layers of sliced avocado, glazed freshwater eel, fresh salmon, tuna, and yellowtail resembling vibrant scales.

subSections.name: Tempura Rolls
subSections.description: Warm, crunchy, and hearty rolls featuring golden flash-fried soft-shell crab, crispy panko shrimp, or entire whole rolls flash-fried in light tempura batter.

choices.label: Extra Hot (Ghost Pepper Togarashi & Fresh Jalapeño)
All Sauces Served on the Side
Crown with Torched A5 Wagyu Beef Slice

sections.name: Ramen & Noodles
sections.description: Soul-warming bowls of artisanal Japanese noodle soups and chilled noodle specialties. Featuring rich, collagen-infused broths simmered for hours, springy alkaline noodles made from select wheat flours, thick chewy udon in golden dashi, and chilled buckwheat soba served with savory dipping tsuyu.

subSections.name: Ramen (Tonkotsu/Miso/Shoyu/Shio)
subSections.description: Iconic regional ramen broths—rich 16-hour simmered pork bone Tonkotsu, fermented Hokkaido Miso, aromatic Tokyo Shoyu soy broth, and clear sea salt Shio broth—served with hand-crafted noodles.

subSections.name: Udon
subSections.description: Plump, chewy Sanuki wheat noodles served piping hot in comforting kombu-bonito dashi broth with tempura flakes or chilled with dipping tsuyu.

subSections.name: Soba
subSections.description: Earthy, nutty Japanese buckwheat noodles served cold on a traditional bamboo zaru with chilled dipping sauce and wasabi, or immersed in soothing hot broth.

choices.label: Extra Rich & Hearty (Kotteri with Rendered Pork Fat)
Infused with Roasted Black Garlic Oil (Mayu)
Slow-Braised Pork Belly Chashu (2 Thick Slices)
House-Made Spicy Garlic Rayu Chili Crisp

sections.name: Rice Bowls (Donburi)
sections.description: Satisfying, hearty Japanese comfort meals served over piping hot beds of steamed Japanese short-grain rice. Ranging from exquisite chirashi bowls layered with raw sashimi jewels to crispy panko cutlets simmered in sweet dashi egg glaze, caramelized teriyaki, and marinated Hawaiian-style poke bowls.

subSections.name: Chirashi
subSections.description: Jeweled bowls of seasoned sushi rice artfully layered with an opulent assortment of fresh raw fish slices, tamago omelet, ikura caviar, and shredded nori.

subSections.name: Katsu Don
subSections.description: Crispy golden panko-breaded pork or chicken cutlets simmered in sweet-savory dashi with sliced sweet onions and gently beaten farm egg over steaming rice.

subSections.name: Teriyaki Bowls
subSections.description: Tender grilled chicken, beef, salmon, or tofu tossed in artisanal caramelized teriyaki glaze with wok-tossed seasonal vegetables over rice.

subSections.name: Poke Bowls
subSections.description: Fresh cubes of raw tuna or salmon marinated in sesame soy, accompanied by edamame, cucumber, ripe avocado, seaweed salad, and masago over rice or fresh salad greens.

choices.label: Half Steamed Rice & Half Mixed Salad Greens
Chef's Assortment of Fresh Raw Sashimi (Tuna, Salmon, Yellowtail)
Add House Japanese Golden Curry Sauce Ladle

sections.name: Appetizers & Small Plates
sections.description: Savory Japanese starters (zensai), crispy izakaya-style bites, and delicate grilled skewers designed to awaken the palate before the main course or accompany sake and cold beer. Encompassing refreshing edamame, golden pan-fried gyoza, lace-battered tempura, and binchotan charcoal-grilled yakitori skewers.

subSections.name: Edamame & Cold Starters
subSections.description: Chilled and warm plant-based starters including steamed edamame pods, sesame seaweed salad (chuka wakame), sunomono pickled cucumbers, and cold silken tofu (hiyayakko).

subSections.name: Gyoza & Tempura
subSections.description: Crispy pan-seared pork, chicken, and vegetable dumplings alongside airy, golden lace-battered colossal prawns and fresh seasonal garden vegetables.

subSections.name: Grilled Skewers (Yakitori)
subSections.description: Binchotan charcoal-grilled skewers of marinated chicken thigh and scallions (negima), tender pork belly, ground chicken meatballs (tsukune), and glazed shiitake mushrooms.

choices.label: Classic Gyoza Citrus Soy & Rayu Chili Dip
Warm Tentsuyu Dashi Tempura Broth with Grated Daikon
Wok-Tossed Spicy Garlic & Rayu Chili Oil
Aromatic White Truffle Butter & Sea Salt
Shio (Flaky Sea Salt & Fresh Squeezed Lemon)

sections.name: Hot Kitchen
sections.description: Hearty cooked entrées from our hot culinary line, highlighting authentic Japanese cooking traditions beyond sushi. From sizzling teppanyaki iron plates and caramelized teriyaki sautés to comprehensive, multi-compartment bento box feasts complete with staple sides.

subSections.name: Teriyaki
subSections.description: Sizzling skillet entrées glazed with our house-crafted reduction of Japanese dark soy, mirin, and sake, served over tender stir-fried cabbage and bean sprouts.

subSections.name: Teppanyaki
subSections.description: High-heat flat-top griddle dishes prepared with garlic butter, soy sauce, and sea salt, showcasing prime beef cuts, succulent scallops, and crisp garden vegetables.

subSections.name: Bento Boxes
subSections.description: Traditional compartmentalized meal sets featuring a featured entrée alongside steamed rice, crispy pork gyoza, 4 pieces of California roll, miso soup, and ginger-dressed salad.

choices.label: USDA Prime New York Strip Steak (8 oz)
Miyazaki A5 Japanese Wagyu Beef (5 oz Upgrade)
Garlic Butter Jumbo Tiger Prawns (5 pcs)
Teppan Japanese Garlic Butter Fried Rice

Include Traditional Tofu Miso Soup & House Ginger Salad

sections.name: Desserts
sections.description: Delectable Japanese desserts and sweet confections providing an elegant, refreshing, and balanced finale to the dining experience. Encompassing chewy ice-cream filled mochi rice dough, cloud-like cotton cheesecakes, and traditional warm wagashi sweets.

subSections.name: Mochi Ice Cream
subSections.description: Chewy, velvety pounded sweet rice dough encasing artisanal ice cream in traditional and contemporary Japanese flavors.

subSections.name: Japanese Cheesecake
subSections.description: Pillow-soft, jiggly soufflé cotton baked cheesecakes celebrated for their airy texture, delicate vanilla notes, and subtle sweetness.

subSections.name: Traditional Sweets
subSections.description: Beloved heritage desserts including crispy warm red bean-filled taiyaki waffles, honey dorayaki pancakes, and layered matcha green tea parfaits.

choices.label: Chef's Dessert Sampler Platter for Table Sharing
Kuromitsu (Okinawan Black Sugar Syrup) & Kinako Powder
Fresh Chantilly Whipped Cream & Sliced Strawberries

sections.name: Sake & Japanese Beverages
sections.description: A premier alcoholic beverage program curated to complement sushi, sashimi, and grilled izakaya specialties. Showcasing artisanal hot and chilled premium sakes, crisp Japanese draft and craft beers, distinguished Japanese single-malt whiskies, and earthy shochu spirits. Subject to digital age verification.

subSections.name: Hot Sake
subSections.description: Comforting, earthy, and full-bodied sakes gently heated to Nurukan (~40°C) or Atsukan (~50°C) to accentuate robust rice umami, served in ceramic tokkuri carafes.

subSections.name: Cold Sake
subSections.description: Crisp, floral, and aromatic premium chilled sakes including Junmai, Ginjo, and fragrant Junmai Daiginjo served in crystal wine glasses or cedar masu boxes with overflowing sake cups (mokkiri).

subSections.name: Japanese Beer
subSections.description: Ultra-crisp, refreshing Japanese draft lagers (Asahi Super Dry, Sapporo Premium, Kirin Ichiban) and regional craft rice ales (Echigo, Hitachino Nest White Ale).

subSections.name: Japanese Whisky
subSections.description: World-renowned Japanese single malts and blended whiskies served neat, over hand-carved ice spheres, or mixed into effervescent, crisp highballs with chilled club soda and lemon peel.

subSections.name: Shochu
subSections.description: Traditional single-distilled spirits crafted from barley (mugi), sweet potato (imo), or rice (kome), served straight, on the rocks, or diluted with hot water (oyuwari) or green tea.

choices.label: Overflowing Cup in Cedar Masu Box (6 oz / 180 ml)
Chilled Draft Pint (16 oz - For Beers)
On the Rocks (Over Hand-Carved Clear Ice Sphere)
Japanese Highball (Fever-Tree Soda, Chilled Glass, Lemon Twist)
Mizuwari (Cut with Cold Spring Water & Clear Ice)
Ryokucha-wari (Mixed with Chilled House Green Tea)

sections.name: Non-Alcoholic Beverages
sections.description: Refreshing, alcohol-free Japanese beverages thoughtfully chosen to cleanse the palate between rich sushi courses. Featuring freshly brewed hot and chilled loose-leaf green teas, playful Japanese Ramune marble sodas, lightly tart Calpico yogurt drinks, and crisp mineral waters.

subSections.name: Japanese Green Tea
subSections.description: Authentic Japanese teas steeped to perfection—including nutty Genmaicha roasted rice green tea, vegetal Sencha, toasty amber Hojicha, and creamy whisked iced Matcha.

subSections.name: Ramune & Soft Drinks
subSections.description: Classic glass Codd-neck bottles sealed with glass marbles (Ramune) in nostalgic fruit flavors, Calpico Japanese yogurt drinks, and craft ginger sodas.

subSections.name: Water
subSections.description: Chilled still spring water, iced cucumber-mint infused carafes, and effervescent sparkling mineral water bottles.

choices.label: Hot Steeping Pot (Free Refills with Hot Water)
Chilled Unsweetened Iced Tea (16 oz Glass)
Iced Sweetened Matcha Latte with Oat Milk

sections.name: Omakase & Set Menus
sections.description: The pinnacle of Japanese hospitality and culinary expression—multi-course 'Chef's Choice' omakase feasts and bundled course menus. Each tier orchestrates an exquisite progression from delicate seasonal appetizers through prized seasonal nigiri and warm kitchen courses to artisanal dessert, tailored to diners' dietary specifications.

timeBehavior.note: Lunch sets available during midday service (11:30 - 15:00); Dinner courses and Omakase served through evening service.

subSections.name: Omakase Tiers (Standard/Premium/Grand)
subSections.description: Exclusive piece-by-piece chef's counter tasting experiences spotlighting the finest daily seafood imports flown direct from Tokyo's Toyosu fish market.

subSections.name: Lunch Sets
subSections.description: Streamlined midday combination sets pairing chef nigiri or roll selections with savory tempura, salad, and dashi miso soup for swift executive dining.

subSections.name: Dinner Courses
subSections.description: Structured multi-course dinner menus presenting an introductory seasonal starter, sashimi flight, entrée choice, signature sushi course, and confectionery finish.

systemFeatures.name: Piece-Count Ordering & Configuration
systemFeatures.description: Enables piece-count ordering models for nigiri (2pc/4pc), sashimi (5pc/10pc/15pc), maki rolls (6pc/8pc), and tasting platters with automated unit price calculation and inventory tracking.

systemFeatures.name: Age Verification Gate
systemFeatures.description: Enforces mandatory legal drinking age verification prompts before guests can add hot sake, cold craft sake, Japanese beers, Japanese whisky, or shochu to their order ticket.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Raw Fish Indicators
systemFeatures.description: Displays visual allergen badges, dietary indicators, and raw seafood consumption warnings across all menu cards, supporting real-time allergen filtering for guests.

systemFeatures.name: Real-Time Fresh Market Inventory Badges
systemFeatures.description: Live stock indicators displaying daily fresh Toyosu market catches, seasonal specials, limited portions, and sold-out badges synchronized with kitchen cutting boards.

systemFeatures.name: Omakase & Set Menus Engine
systemFeatures.description: Configures multi-course omakase tasting tiers, bundled lunch combos, and multi-course dinner services with course-by-course pacing and dietary restriction tracking.

systemFeatures.name: Spice Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Enables customers to calibrate heat and togarashi levels across specialty spicy rolls, ramen broths, donburi bowls, and dipping sauces.
